lines.interests: You say what you want to read about. Your interests, not training, rank the articles, so there is nothing to train first.
lines.lanes: Articles are sorted into For you, Maybe, Everything else and New. New holds the ones that are not analyzed yet, and you can read them right away.
lines.why: Press “Why this?” on any article to see why it is where it is.

feeds.title: Add your feeds
feeds.lead: Fetching and reading work without any AI, and every new feed starts with classification Off. You decide later, feed by feed, whether anything is analyzed.
feeds.needOne: Add at least one feed to continue.

bundles.title: Starter bundles
bundles.lead: Not sure where to start? Add a ready-made group of feeds. Adding a bundle never turns classification on.
bundles.needsChoice: This website offers several feeds. Add it from the address field above to choose one.

interests.title: What do you want to read about?
interests.lead: Pick a few topics or describe your own. Your interests decide what appears in “For you”.

like.title: Pick topics you like
like.lead: Press a topic to add it, and press it again to take it away.

never.title: Never show me…
never.lead: Optional. Articles about these topics are hidden or pushed far down.

interests.blockedByNever: You already chose this under “Never show me…”.
interests.blockedByLike: You already chose this under “Pick topics you like”.

describe.title: Or describe it yourself
describe.label: Describe something you want to read about
describe.hint: For example: “Electric cars and batteries”, “Slovak politics” or “Beginner Rust tutorials”.

warn.title: Continue without interests?
warn.body: Without an interest, “For you” stays empty until Bantoozi has learned from what you read and rate. You can add interests later under Interests.

calibrate.title: Choose articles to teach Bantoozi
calibrate.lead: Pick a few articles you would enjoy reading. Bantoozi analyzes only the ones you choose and learns from them. You can skip this step and do it later.
calibrate.noArticles: No articles from this feed yet
calibrate.noArticlesBody: They appear once the feed has been fetched. You can finish now and choose articles later.

progress.title: Progress
progress.note: Analysis runs in the background. You can finish at any time.

round.title: Rate a few articles
round.lead: These were analyzed from your selection. Like or dislike them to show Bantoozi what you want.
round.empty: No articles are ready to rate yet.

automatic.title: Automatic classification
automatic.lead: Optional, and separate from the selection above. When you enable it for a feed, new articles from that feed are analyzed as they arrive. Articles already in the feed stay manual: only the ones you choose are analyzed.
